'''Lirka''' was a [[Sephi/Legends|Sephi]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who lived in the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Along with a [[Unidentified Sephi aide|colleague]], she [[Senatorial aide|assisted]] the Sephi [[Politics/Legends|politician]] [[Navi]] in his [[Senator/Legends|senatorial]] duties during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], until he was arrested for crimes against the Republic in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].

==Biography==
[[File:Navi_arrested.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Lirka and her colleague were present when Navi was arrested.]]
A [[Gender/Legends|female]] of the [[Sephi/Legends|Sephi]] [[Species/Legends|species]], Lirka lived during the waning [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a pan&ndash;[[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] conflict between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist Confederacy]], she had gotten involved in [[Politics/Legends|politics]]. She served as an [[Senatorial aide|aide]] to [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Navi]],<ref name="JY" /> who represented their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Thustra/Legends|Thustra]] and the whole [[Sumitra sector/Legends|Sumitra sector]]<ref name="Atlas">In ''[[Jedi: Yoda]]'', [[Navi]] was referred to as the [[Senator/Legends|senator]] of [[Thustra/Legends|Thustra]]. However, ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' states that the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] was composed of [[Sector/Legends|sectorial]] senators rather than [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] ones. According to the [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]], Thustra was located within the [[Sumitra sector/Legends|Sumitra sector]]. Therefore, Navi must have represented that sector.</ref> in the Republic [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]]. She shared her duties with [[Unidentified Sephi aide|another Sephi woman]], and the two [[Clothing/Legends|dressed]] in an almost identical fashion.<ref name="JY" />

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref><ref name="Heroes on Both Sides">{{TCW|Heroes on Both Sides}}</ref> Senator Navi was found guilty of crimes against the Republic and conspiracy to commit [[Death/Legends|murder]] on [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. He was arrested by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] in the middle of a Senate plenary session. Lirka and her counterpart were present in the Senate's [[Grand Convocation Chamber]] when that happened, and the two expressed shock and dismay over the incident, as two [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guards]] were taking their superior into custody.<ref name="JY" />

==Personality and traits==
Around 22 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]], Lirka was still a youthful Sephi. She had [[Color/Legends|pink]], smooth skin and sported straight, dark-brown [[Hair/Legends|hair]] that reached below the knees in the back.<ref name="JY" />

==Equipment==
When sitting in the Senate, she wore a close-fitting red-and-[[Gold/Legends|gold]] tunic with bell-shaped sleeves and a pair of black, over-the-knee [[Boot/Legends|boots]] with high heels. She also used a red folding fan as a fashion accessory.<ref name="JY" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lirka appeared in the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] ''[[Jedi: Yoda]]'', the fifth and final issue in the [[Star Wars: Jedi (one-shots)|''Star Wars: Jedi'']] series of comics,<ref name="JY" /> which was released on [[July 21]], [[2004]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54285/star_wars_jedi_-_yoda_2004_1|text=Star Wars: Jedi - Yoda (2004) #1}}</ref> The comic was written by [[Jeremy Barlow]] and illustrated by [[HOON]]. The two Sephi aides featured in the comic were mostly identical, with one wearing black cuissardes and the other white ones. Even though the aides were only background characters and had no lines,<ref name="JY" /> HOON still produced a detailed rendering of the one wearing black boots as part of his conceptual "sephi character catalogue." Although unnamed in the comic, that character was identified as "Senator Aid Lirka" in the aforementioned piece of concept art.<ref name="HOON">{{WebCite|url=http://www.messs.cc/gallery/albums.php|text=MESS STUDIO art Gallery :: Jedi: Yoda-Unsheathed :: Pic1|author=[[HOON]]|work=[https://web.archive.org/web/20080125025203/http://www.messs.cc/gallery/albums.php MESS STUDIO art Gallery]|archivedate=20080125025203}}</ref>
